### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name why an installation's sessions are unreadable](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2828) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — When the Sessions page can't read an installation, its banner names the reason and a request id, e.g. `authentication failed, request id …`. For operators: the backend logs each failed read with the installation, status and the same request id.

### Development and CI/CD

- (chart) [Connect to the CNPG database with TLS against its CA](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2829) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — With `database.engine: postgresql`, the backend connects to its CNPG database over TLS and verifies the server certificate against the mounted CA, instead of connecting in plain text.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.93.0...v2.93.1
